prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. One finished landscape 3:2 full-bleed picture-book illustration, one coherent scene and moment, no panels or contact sheet. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
WD-KIT / Kit: six-year-old human boy, golden light-medium skin, short straight black side-parted hair, teal T-shirt, mustard shorts, navy sneakers. The ONLY named human protagonist is Kit. Zoe MUST NOT appear. Ignore every other child shown in reference sheets; unnamed adults may appear only when this scene explicitly requires them. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: Follow the Park Map; World Discovery; nonfiction.
Setting: World Discovery small enclosed park in daylight. Fixed plan: entrance gate at south/bottom; a straight path reaches one bench at a central fork; right branch passes one tall tree and reaches a kidney-shaped pond at northeast/top-right; left branch ends at a flowerbed. No roads.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): One square paper park map with pictorial gate, bench, tree, pond and flowerbed connected by the exact established paths; One real brown bench; One real tall green tree; One curved pond
 Input references lock identity, prop design and location; compose a NEW image for the exact scene, never reproduce the reference-board layout. The reference and overall prop list may contain finished objects and later story events: these are DESIGN REFERENCES ONLY, not permission to show them now. Show only the people, objects and development stage required below.
Page 2. Printed prose (NOT text to put in art): A blue shape stands for the pond. A small gate picture shows the entrance.
Required illustration: World Discovery small enclosed park in daylight. Fixed plan: entrance gate at south/bottom; a straight path reaches one bench at a central fork; right branch passes one tall tree and reaches a kidney-shaped pond at northeast/top-right; left branch ends at a flowerbed. No roads. Close view of Kit’s map clearly shows the blue kidney-shaped pond at top-right and brown gate picture at bottom-center. Exact state: Other established landmarks and fork remain in their fixed positions; no text.
Exact current state: Other established landmarks and fork remain in their fixed positions; no text.
Do not add later events, duplicate props or a separate inset. No written title; the app renders live text.
Critical composition and map consistency: Close overhead view of ONE square paper map in Kit's two hands; the map dominates image. Gate symbol bottom-center, path north to bench at central Y fork, left branch ending in flowerbed, right branch past tree to kidney pond TOP RIGHT. No actual pond or bench outside the paper in this close crop. No lettering, compass letters, numbers or arrows.

visualReview.note: Directly inspected: single paper map fills frame in two hands; gate bottom, bench at fork, flowerbed left and tree before pond right; no misleading extra labels.
visualReview.limits: Direct agent image/sequence inspection; not physical classroom observation.
